EmuTOS 1.4 - free operating system for the Atari ST (https://emutos.sourceforge.io)
Distributed unmodified under the GNU GPL v2 (see EmuTOS-LICENSE.txt).
Source code: https://sourceforge.net/projects/emutos/files/emutos/1.4/

Files bundled with the Atari ST core:

  tos.img              EmuTOS 192 KB, English (PAL)  - loaded automatically.
                       For Machine = ST with the 68000 CPU (the core's defaults).
  emutos-256k-uk.img   EmuTOS 256 KB, English (PAL)  - for STE, Mega STE or the 68020 CPU.
  emutos-192k-fr.img   EmuTOS 192 KB, French (AZERTY keyboard layout)
  emutos-256k-fr.img   EmuTOS 256 KB, French (AZERTY keyboard layout)

To switch, pick a file in Core Settings -> TOS on the Pocket (the ST resets),
or rename it to tos.img.

EmuTOS is compatible with most well-behaved ST software, but some games and
demos only run on Atari's original TOS. If you own an original TOS dump you can
use it instead: copy it here as tos.img.
